Green. 625 passing, 0 failing.

Three cases failed, all in `order totals`. `orderTotal` taxed the pre-discount amount. It now taxes the discounted amount, as its own doc comment says.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Only rows with both a discount and a tax showed it.
